title: BUG: Deflect surcharge is actually collected — after choosing the poro the spare [rainbow] is spent (809)

repro.testName: BUG: Deflect surcharge is actually collected — after choosing the poro the spare [rainbow] is spent (809)

history.note: Deflect surcharge for a RESOLUTION-time target is uncollected in three places; resolve.ts only taxes non-spell auto-bound single candidates, pending-choice.ts choose-target never charges, and a modal spell's inner effect auto-targets through _helpers.getTargetIds with no charge site at all. Charging in getTargetIds would over-charge quantity:'all' criteria selections; needs a real 'chosen at resolution' hook first.
